name: text-gravity-drop-out
title: Gravity Drop Out
description: Các ký tự lần lượt rung nhẹ rồi rơi khỏi dòng theo trọng lực, xoay nghiêng ngẫu nhiên.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Split chars, random order (seeded), 40 ms apart (demo 120 ms capped 0.8 s), from 0.8 s. Each char falls y 0 → 100vh in 1 s easeInQuad (labelled power2.in; demo true gravity y = ½·900 px/s²·t²), rotating to a seeded ±40° (demo reaches it at 0.7 s), x drift up to ±15 px/s. Demo: for 0.22 s before falling each char wobbles on its baseline (rot = sin(18w)·0.06·w rad, w 0 → 1). Loop: text fades back 2.6–3.1 s; loop 3.2 s. Params: duration (1 s) · stagger: ngẫu nhiên (0.04 s) · rotate (±40°) · drop (100vh) · wobble: rung trước khi rơi (0.22 s).
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự rơi khỏi dòng theo trọng lực
